abstract: [JAMA network open] Although external validation of machine learning (ML)-based delirium risk models is a key stage in the model development pipeline, few published reports exist. Moreover, ML-based delirium risk models commonly degrade in performance during external validation. To examine the performance of a fusion multimodal with natural language processing (NLP) delirium risk stratification model in live clinical practice with cross-hospital external validation. This quality improvement study evaluated live clinical deployment of the model among patients 60 years or older who were admitted to non-intensive care units at Mount Sinai Hospital (MSH), with external validation performed at Mount Sinai Morningside Hospital (MSM), from December 1, 2024, to December 31, 2025. Primary outcomes were performance of the risk stratification model, assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and monthly delirium detection rates. A 2 × 2 confusion matrix was created, and the 4 cells were used to calculate model performance metrics and compare associated diagnostic yield between premodel deployment and active model deployment periods. The overall sample included 33 095 admissions to non-intensive care units at MSM and MSH (mean [SD] age, 74.86 (9.22) years; 15 601 women [47.1%], 17 271 men [52.2%]). A total of 9020 MSM inpatient admissions were assigned a delirium risk score by the risk stratification model during live clinical operations and were compared to 21 186 MSH inpatient admissions that were assigned a risk score by the same model. abstract: [JAMA network open] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used to support maternal health, but randomized evidence is limited. To evaluate whether access to a generative AI maternal health chatbot improved 12-month maternal health outcomes. This 2-group randomized clinical trial enrolled 400 participants from October 2023 to December 2024, with 12-month follow-up completed in December 2025. Participants were recruited online across 49 US states and the District of Columbia. Eligible participants were English-speaking, aged 14 years or older, pregnant or parenting an infant younger than 6 months, and self-identified as members of racial and/or ethnic minoritized groups. Participants were randomized 1:1 to receive access to the chatbot or an active control consisting of monthly children's books. Primary outcomes were anxiety and depression symptoms at 12 months measured using the Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 and Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Secondary outcomes included emergency department visits, pregnancy-related complications, postpartum care checkups, effective contraception use, and sleep duration. Among 400 randomized participants, the mean (SD) age was 32.6 (5.1) years; 200 (50%) were parenting an infant at enrollment; and 10 (2%) identified as American Indian or Alaska Native, 80 (20%) Asian, 188 (47%) Black or African American, 57 (14%) multiracial, and 65 (16%) Hispanic or Latino. The AI chatbot was not associated with differences in anxiety scores (adjusted mean difference, 0.10; 95% CI, -0.77 to 0.96) or depression scores (adjusted mean difference, -0.23; 95% CI, -1.05 to 0.59), nor with emergency department visits, postpartum care, contraception use, or sleep duration. Among participants pregnant at enrollment, the chatbot was associated with more self-reported pregnancy-related complications in the secondary 12-month end point analysis, but not in longitudinal analyses. Higher chatbot engagement was associated with longer sleep duration and higher anxiety scores in exploratory within-group analyses. In this randomized clinical trial of pregnant and postpartum individuals from racial and ethnic minoritized groups, access to a generative artificial intelligence maternal health chatbot did not improve maternal anxiety or depression at 12 months compared with an active control. Secondary and exploratory findings should be interpreted cautiously. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06053515.
zh_abstract: [JAMA network open] 生成式人工智能（AI）聊天机器人越来越多地用于支持孕产妇健康，但随机对照证据有限。评估获取生成式AI孕产妇健康聊天机器人是否改善了12个月孕产妇健康结局。这项两组随机临床试验于2023年10月至2024年12月纳入400名参与者，12个月随访于2025年12月完成。参与者通过线上方式在美国49个州和哥伦比亚特区招募。符合条件的参与者为说英语、年龄14岁或以上、怀孕或正在养育小于6个月婴儿，并自我认同为种族和/或族裔少数群体成员。参与者按1:1随机分配接受该聊天机器人访问权，或接受由每月儿童书籍构成的主动对照。主要结局为12个月时使用广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7（Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7）和患者健康问卷-9（Patient Health Questionnaire-9）测量的焦虑和抑郁症状。次要结局包括急诊就诊、妊娠相关并发症、产后保健检查、有效避孕使用和睡眠时长。在400名随机参与者中，平均（SD）年龄为32.6（5.1）岁；200名（50%）在入组时正在养育婴儿；10名（2%）自我认同为美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民，80名（20%）为亚裔，188名（47%）为黑人或非裔美国人，57名（14%）为多种族，65名（16%）为西班牙裔或拉丁裔。AI聊天机器人与焦虑评分（调整后平均差，0.10；95% CI，-0.77至0.96）或抑郁评分（调整后平均差，-0.23；95% CI，-1.05至0.59）的差异无关，也与急诊就诊、产后保健、避孕使用或睡眠时长无关。在入组时怀孕的参与者中，该聊天机器人在12个月次要终点分析中与更多自我报告的妊娠相关并发症相关，但在纵向分析中不相关。在探索性组内分析中，较高的聊天机器人参与度与更长的睡眠时长和更高的焦虑评分相关。在这项针对种族和族裔少数群体孕妇和产后个体的随机临床试验中，与主动对照相比，获取生成式人工智能孕产妇健康聊天机器人未改善12个月时的孕产妇焦虑或抑郁。次要和探索性发现应谨慎解读。ClinicalTrials.gov 标识符：NCT06053515。

title: Cross-paradigm audit of large language model judges for clinical text evaluation

abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用汇总的一致性指标，掩盖了具有临床相关性的失效模式。本研究以专家评判者为参照，审计了六个开放权重模型在四个德语临床数据集上的表现，这些数据集涵盖报告和护理记录摘要、出院摘要生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因标准和语料而异，且没有任何配置在所有范式中均被证明可靠。所有评判者均表现出位置偏倚和身份偏倚。用LLM作为评判者替代专家小组后，57.2%的逐点类别发生偏移，41.7%的成对胜者被调换，10.2%的临床错误被漏检，并通过高估“简洁”和“准确”标准而颠倒了临床优先次序。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM作为评判者并非专家的安全替代品，部署阈值应遵循针对临床情境中LLM作为评判者的决策影响分析。

title: A multimodal tool-augmented agent for evidence-based clinical decision support in longitudinal AMD follow-up

abstract: Clinical management of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires longitudinal decisions on disease activity, treatment response, and anti-VEGF injection intervals. These decisions depend on integrating multimodal retinal imaging findings across visits, yet manual synthesis is time-consuming and may omit relevant information, limiting transparency and consistency in follow-up planning. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored to summarize longitudinal AMD information, but existing approaches may lack explicit quantitative grounding and evidence attribution, reducing their auditability in clinical decision support. To address these limitations, we developed AMDagent, an evidence-grounded clinical agent that integrates quantitative imaging analysis with guideline retrieval to generate structured, clinician-facing decision-support outputs. The system links longitudinal imaging findings to actionable management considerations while preserving traceable evidence sources. In a 20-case proof-of-concept evaluation of curated longitudinal AMD cases, AMDagent was rated clinically appropriate in 92.0% of predefined decision-support units under expert adjudication. In addition, 83.3% of audited major clinical claims were explicitly grounded in tool-derived quantitative measurements and/or retrieved guideline evidence, enabling clinician verification. These preliminary findings suggest that evidence-grounded, clinician-facing agents may support more transparent and auditable longitudinal AMD decision support, although larger prospective multi-center studies are needed to assess generalizability and clinical utility.
zh_abstract: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）的临床管理需要对疾病活动性、治疗反应和抗VEGF注射间隔作出纵向决策。这些决策依赖于整合跨访视的多模态视网膜影像发现，但人工综合耗时，且可能遗漏相关信息，从而限制随访计划的透明性和一致性。大语言模型（LLMs）已被探索用于总结纵向AMD信息，但现有方法可能缺乏明确的定量依据和证据归属，从而降低其在临床决策支持中的可审计性。为解决这些局限，我们开发了 AMDagent，这是一种以证据为基础的临床智能体，将定量影像分析与指南检索相结合，以生成结构化的、面向临床医生的决策支持输出。该系统将纵向影像发现与可执行的管理考量联系起来，同时保留可追溯的证据来源。在针对精选纵向AMD病例的20例概念验证评估中，在专家裁定下，AMDagent 在预定义决策支持单元中有92.0%被评为临床适当。此外，在经审计的主要临床主张中，83.3%明确基于工具得出的定量测量和/或检索到的指南证据，从而使临床医生能够核验。这些初步发现表明，以证据为基础、面向临床医生的智能体可能支持更透明、更可审计的纵向AMD决策支持，但仍需要更大规模的前瞻性多中心研究来评估其可推广性和临床实用性。

title: A multi-guideline clinical agent for vascular surgery: architecture, implementation, and benchmark evaluation.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] The clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) published by the European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) span approximately 1100 pages whose simultaneous cross-referencing is impractical at the point of care. Unguarded large language models (LLMs) carry hallucination risk, motivating a guideline-locked design. We describe the architecture and development of a context-aware clinical agent encompassing the full ESVS corpus of 14 CPGs. The system extends a validated single-guideline GraphRAG prototype with an LLM-driven Guideline Router, an embedded Context Gate that withholds retrieval when decision-critical parameters are absent, dual-channel retrieval, and GPT-5 synthesis under a mandatory citation template. An automated benchmark assessed the final system on 55 vignettes, scored by 2 blinded LLM judges over 3 runs (330 judgments), with clinician adjudication of every flagged claim. The system stayed within its locked corpus, declined all out-of-scope queries, and achieved 98.4% guideline-routing recall. The Context Gate showed 91.9% specificity and 78.6% sensitivity for underspecified queries, and all 259 cited recommendations were verifiable within the locked corpus. Automated judges flagged an unsupported claim in 18.2% of items under a sensitive screening definition; on adjudication by 2 vascular surgeons, 7.3% of items contained a clinically consequential error, none graded capable of causing harm. Clinical acceptability of complete answers was not scored and is reserved for prospective expert evaluation. These results support the feasibility of a multi-guideline context-aware clinical agent for vascular surgery; citation traceability and locked-corpus provenance facilitate future auditability.
zh_abstract: [《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》] 欧洲血管外科学会（ESVS）发布的临床实践指南（CPGs）篇幅约 1100 页，在诊疗现场同时进行交叉查阅并不现实。未加约束的大语言模型（LLMs）存在幻觉风险，这促使研究者采用锁定于指南语料的设计。我们介绍一个覆盖 ESVS 全部 14 部 CPG 语料的上下文感知临床代理的架构与开发过程。该系统在已验证的单指南 GraphRAG 原型基础上进行了扩展，加入了由 LLM 驱动的指南路由器（Guideline Router）、内嵌的上下文闸门（Context Gate；当缺少决策关键参数时不进行检索）、双通道检索，以及在强制引用模板下由 GPT-5 进行综合。一项自动化基准在 55 个情景案例（vignettes）上评估最终系统，由 2 名盲法 LLM 评审员评阅 3 轮（共 330 次判定），并对每一条被标记的论断由临床医生裁定。系统始终限定在其锁定的语料库范围内，拒绝了所有超出范围的查询，指南路由召回率达到 98.4%。对于表述不充分的查询，上下文闸门的特异度（specificity）为 91.9%、灵敏度（sensitivity）为 78.6%，且全部 259 条被引用的推荐意见均可在锁定语料库内核实。在敏感筛查定义下，自动评审员在 18.2% 的条目中标记出缺乏支持的论断；经 2 名血管外科医生裁定，7.3% 的条目含有具有临床后果的错误，但无一例被评定为可能造成伤害。完整答案的临床可接受性未予评分，留待前瞻性专家评估。这些结果支持用于血管外科的多指南上下文感知临床代理的可行性；引用可追溯性与锁定语料的来源溯源有助于未来的可审计性。

abstract: [Journal of neurosurgical sciences] To evaluate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) tools on workflow efficiency, treatment times, and clinical outcomes in patients with large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke. We included observational studies that assessed the implementation of AI-based tools in the management of patients with suspected or confirmed LVO stroke. Eligible studies reported workflow, treatment, safety, or functional outcomes. Data were extracted on thrombolysis rates, CTA-to-arterial puncture time, door-to-puncture time, endovascular treatment (EVT) access, reperfusion success, symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (sICH), mortality, and functional independence (mRS 0-2) at 90 days. Random-effects models were applied to calculate pooled mean differences (MD) or risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Thirteen studies were included. AI implementation significantly reduced workflow delays: CTA-to-puncture time decreased by -40.20 minutes (95% CI -66.41 to -13.99; P<0.01) and door-to-puncture time by -23.17 minutes (95% CI -38.71 to -7.63; P<0.01). Thrombolysis administration showed no difference (RR 0.79; 95% CI 0.57-1.09; P=0.15). Similarly, no significant effects were observed for EVT access (RR 0.97; 95% CI 0.66-1.44; P=0.89), reperfusion success (RR 1.06; 95% CI 1.00-1.12; P=0.06), sICH (RR 0.63; 95% CI 0.30-1.35; P=0.23), or mortality (RR 0.72; 95% CI 0.38-1.37; P=0.32). However, AI-based workflows significantly improved functional independence at 90 days (RR 1.55; 95% CI 1.12-2.15; P=0.008). AI tools significantly improve treatment times and functional independence in acute LVO stroke without increasing adverse events.

title: All-Atom Structure Tokenizer: AtomLM-9b for Biomolecular Structure Prediction
zh_title: AtomLM-9b：全原子结构分词与结构预测
summary: 预印本发布全原子结构分词器并训练9B自回归模型AtomLM-9b，作者称其蛋白结构预测性能可与AlphaFold 3相比。
key_points: 化学单元压缩为8192个共享结构token
CASP14/CASP15全原子lDDT为0.832和0.835
基于Qwen3.5-9B，从分子序列与连接关系预测结构token
reason: 大规模结构语言模型并在CASP、FoldBench基准上与AF3比较，方法新颖，但为未经同行评审的预印本
abstract: We develop an All-atom Structure Tokenizer that compresses biomolecular geometry into discrete structural tokens and achieves high-accuracy all-atom reconstruction. A hierarchical geometric encoder and finite scalar quantization map chemical units to a shared vocabulary of 8,192 tokens, while a joint coordinate de-tokenizer reconstructs backbone, side-chain, nucleic-acid, and ligand heavy atoms. The tokenizer achieves all-atom lDDT scores of 0.832 and 0.835 on CASP14 and CASP15, respectively. Building on this tokenizer, we train AtomLM-9b, an autoregressive language model based on Qwen3.5-9B that predicts structural tokens from molecular identities and connectivity and decodes them into complete atomic structures. We demonstrate, for the first time, protein structure prediction performance comparable to AlphaFold 3 with an all-atom-tokenizer-based structural language model: on the FoldBench protein-protein task, AtomLM-9b achieves a success rate of 75.01%, compared with the published AlphaFold 3 result of 72.93%. These results establish discrete all-atom tokenization as an effective interface between high-fidelity atomic reconstruction and language-model-based structure prediction.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了全原子结构分词器（All-atom Structure Tokenizer），可将生物分子几何结构压缩为离散结构标记，并实现高精度全原子重建。分层几何编码器和有限标量量化将化学单元映射到包含8,192个标记的共享词表，而联合坐标去分词器重建主链、侧链、核酸和配体重原子。该分词器在CASP14和CASP15上的全原子lDDT分数分别为0.832和0.835。基于该分词器，我们训练了AtomLM-9b，这是一种基于Qwen3.5-9B的自回归语言模型，可从分子身份和连接性预测结构标记，并将其解码为完整原子结构。我们首次展示了使用基于全原子分词器的结构语言模型获得与AlphaFold 3相当的蛋白质结构预测性能：在FoldBench蛋白质-蛋白质任务上，AtomLM-9b的成功率为75.01%，而已发表的AlphaFold 3结果为72.93%。这些结果确立了离散全原子分词作为高保真原子重建与基于语言模型的结构预测之间的有效接口。

title: A 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and segmentation
zh_title: 统一CT解读与三维分割的3D基础模型
summary: 预印本发布HoloCT，统一CT解读与三维分割，覆盖19.6万次扫描与346项任务。
key_points: 构建HoloDATA：195,921次CT、73个公开数据集
含620万指令对话与280万CT-掩膜配对
在346项分割、筛查、VQA与报告任务上评测
reason: 预印本发布大规模3D CT基础模型与数据，任务广泛但未经同行评审
abstract: Radiologists interpret computed tomography (CT) scans by jointly determining what a finding represents and where it lies in three-dimensional (3D) anatomy. However, CT models have treated CT interpretation and 3D segmentation as separate tasks, leaving textual findings spatially unverifiable and overlooking potential synergy between clinical understanding and spatial perception. Here we present HoloCT, a generalist 3D foundation model unifying CT interpretation and voxel-level segmentation by jointly modelling whole-volume context and fine-grained anatomical detail, providing 3D masks as evidence. We curated HoloDATA, comprising 195,921 CT scans from 73 public datasets and six clinical cohorts, with 6.2 million instruction dialogues and 2.8 million CT-mask pairs. Across 346 tasks spanning segmentation, lesion screening, visual question answering, and report generation on 61 internal and 12 external datasets, HoloCT outperformed specialist and foundation models. In multicentre validation across 11,455 clinical CT scans from five hospitals, HoloCT outperformed competing models in lesion segmentation and report generation by 18.2 and 15.3 points. It also achieved 85.1% mean accuracy in screening thyroid tumours and colon lesions, exceeding all four participating radiologists in a retrospective reader study. Further analyses revealed bidirectional semantic-spatial synergy: language-guided segmentation delineated unseen anatomical structures and lesions as well as diffuse free-text findings, outperforming the leading approach by 22.1 points, whereas prompting the model to generate corresponding 3D masks alongside its textual outputs significantly improved interpretation performance. HoloCT shows that clinical understanding and spatial perception can be learned together within a single foundation model and offers a path towards more accurate and reliable CT analysis.
zh_abstract: 放射科医生通过共同确定发现代表什么以及其在三维（3D）解剖中的位置来判读计算机断层扫描（CT）。然而，CT模型将CT判读和3D分割视为独立任务，使文本发现无法在空间上验证，并忽视了临床理解与空间感知之间的潜在协同作用。在此，我们提出HoloCT，一种通用3D基础模型，通过联合建模全容积上下文和细粒度解剖细节，统一CT判读和体素级分割，并提供3D掩膜作为证据。我们构建了HoloDATA，包含来自73个公共数据集和六个临床队列的195,921次CT扫描，以及620万条指令对话和280万对CT-掩膜配对。在涵盖分割、病变筛查、视觉问答和报告生成的346项任务中（61个内部数据集和12个外部数据集），HoloCT优于专科模型和基础模型。在来自五家医院的11,455次临床CT扫描的多中心验证中，HoloCT在病变分割和报告生成方面分别以18.2分和15.3分优于竞争模型。它在筛查甲状腺肿瘤和结肠病变方面还达到了85.1%的平均准确率，在一项回顾性阅片者研究中超过了所有四名参与的放射科医生。进一步分析揭示了双向语义-空间协同作用：语言引导的分割能够描绘未见过的解剖结构和病变以及弥漫性自由文本发现，比领先方法高出22.1分；而提示模型在输出文本的同时生成相应的3D掩膜，则显著提高了判读性能。HoloCT表明，临床理解和空间感知可以在单一基础模型内共同学习，并为更准确、更可靠的CT分析提供了一条路径。

title: EEGDash Corpus: A Training-Ready Public Corpus for EEG Foundation Models
zh_title: EEGDash：面向脑电基础模型的公开训练语料库
summary: 预印本：发布77个公开脑电数据集的训练就绪语料库，共14,075小时、7,272名受试者。
key_points: 77个公开EEG数据集整合为可训练语料
含14,075小时、7,272名受试者数据
以门控Hugging Face数据集形式发布并附文件校验和
reason: 大规模公开可获取脑电数据集，属重要档加分项
abstract: Foundation models for electroencephalography (EEG) are pretrained on tens of thousands of hours of recordings, and their accuracy grows with that amount. Such data is hard to assemble. The largest sources are clinical archives that cannot be redistributed, and the public sources are spread over several archives, file formats, and licences. We release eegdash-corpus-v0, a training-ready corpus of 77 public EEG datasets, as the gated Hugging Face dataset EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0 with the SHA-256 of every file. REVE, the largest published EEG foundation model, names 89 datasets as its pretraining corpus. Twelve cannot be redistributed: four clinical archives that hold 82% of its hours, and eight under no-derivatives licences. The corpus holds the 76 others that REVE's sampling rate allows and one more from REVE's release card: 77 datasets, 14,075 hours from 7,272 subjects, 5.0 million 10-second samples and 6.21 billion tokens per epoch. Every dataset is fetched through EEGDash, converted once with REVE's recipe, and stored in its own buckets of a chunked Zarr store with its licence recorded beside it, so a model can train on the whole store or on any subset of datasets. To test that the store pretrains a model, we retrain REVE-Base from scratch twice with the authors' code, changed only in how it reads data, and score it on seven public OpenEEGBench tasks. It reaches 0.331 under linear probing and 0.273 after fine-tuning, against 0.333 and 0.325 for the released model and 0.200 and 0.205 for an untrained encoder. The converter, the conversion reports, and the loader changes are released with the corpus.
zh_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型是在数万小时记录上预训练的，其准确率随数据量增长。此类数据难以汇集。最大来源是无法再分发的临床档案，公开来源分散在多个档案库、文件格式和许可证中。我们发布 eegdash-corpus-v0，一个可直接用于训练的 77 个公开 EEG 数据集语料库，作为门控 Hugging Face 数据集 EEGDash/eegdash-corpus-v0，并提供每个文件的 SHA-256。已发表的最大 EEG 基础模型 REVE 将 89 个数据集列为其预训练语料库。其中 12 个无法再分发：4 个临床档案库，占其小时数的 82%，以及 8 个采用禁止衍生作品许可证的数据集。该语料库包含 REVE 采样率允许的其余 76 个数据集，以及来自 REVE 发布卡的另外 1 个：共 77 个数据集，来自 7,272 名受试者的 14,075 小时，500 万个 10 秒样本，每个 epoch 62.1 亿个 token。每个数据集均通过 EEGDash 获取，使用 REVE 的配方转换一次，并存储在分块 Zarr 存储中各自的桶中，旁边记录其许可证，因此模型可以在整个存储或任意数据集子集上训练。为测试该存储能否预训练模型，我们使用作者代码从头两次重新训练 REVE-Base，仅更改其读取数据的方式，并在七个公开 OpenEEGBench 任务上评分。线性探测下达到 0.331，微调后达到 0.273，而已发布模型分别为 0.333 和 0.325，未训练编码器分别为 0.200 和 0.205。转换器、转换报告和加载器更改随语料库一同发布。

title: OpenBrain: An Auditable Generated-Label Release for Whole-Brain MRI Parcellation
zh_title: OpenBrain：可审计的全脑MRI分割生成标签发布
summary: 发布来自607个数据集的35,838例溯源核验全脑MRI分割标签，附置信分层与无参考质控指标。
key_points: 每条记录含主分割、两个委员会分割及来源与许可信息
QC-7面板覆盖标签几何、图文一致性与委员会分歧
用户可据风险分数与置信层级过滤、加权或重设阈值
reason: 公开可获取的3.5万例大规模标注发布并附可审计质控，属重要档
abstract: Automatic tools can now generate whole-brain MRI parcellations at cohort scale, but generated-label releases often provide little evidence about which cases are reliable enough to reuse. We introduce OpenBrain, a confidence-aware release of 35,838 provenance-verified OpenNeuro T1w cases from 607 source datasets. OpenBrain is organized as an auditable case-record release rather than a directory of standalone segmentation files: each record links a primary parcellation, two committee parcellations, source/license provenance, raw QC-7 measurements, percentile risks, a combined risk score R, and a confidence tier. QC-7 is a reference-free reliability panel over label geometry, image-label consistency, and committee disagreement, so users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold generated labels without rerunning inference. We evaluate this released evidence under a frozen protocol. Across external cohorts, lower QC-7 risk corresponds to higher generated-label quality; in fixed-budget training, lower-risk selections improve paired macro Dice over random selection by +3.2 to +3.7 percentage points. OpenBrain also exposes raw axes, committee outputs, provenance, and datasheet documentation, so confidence claims remain inspectable after download. It does not turn generated labels into manual annotations or clinical-grade segmentations. Its contribution is a large open generated-parcellation substrate, a reusable case-level risk-evidence layer, and an external validation protocol for release-time QC. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain. Code: https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain.
zh_abstract: 自动工具现在可以在队列规模上生成全脑MRI脑区划分（parcellations），但生成标签的发布往往很少提供证据说明哪些病例足够可靠可供复用。我们推出OpenBrain，这是一个带有置信度感知的发布集，包含来自607个源数据集的35,838个经来源验证的OpenNeuro T1w病例。OpenBrain组织为可审计的病例记录发布，而非独立分割文件的目录：每条记录链接一个主要脑区划分、两个委员会脑区划分、来源/许可出处、原始QC-7测量、百分位风险、综合风险评分R和置信度层级。QC-7是一个无参考的可靠性评估面板，涵盖标签几何、图像-标签一致性和委员会分歧，因此用户无需重新运行推理即可对生成标签进行筛选、加权、审计或重新设定阈值。我们在冻结协议下评估这一已发布证据。在外部队列中，较低的QC-7风险对应较高的生成标签质量；在固定预算训练中，较低风险选择相比随机选择将配对宏Dice提高+3.2至+3.7个百分点。OpenBrain还公开原始轴、委员会输出、来源和datasheet文档，因此置信度声明在下载后仍可检查。它不会将生成标签变成人工标注或临床级分割。其贡献是一个大型开放生成脑区划分基础资源、一个可复用的病例级风险证据层，以及一个用于发布时QC的外部验证协议。数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/lanqz7766/OpenBrain。代码：https://github.com/lanqz7766/openbrain。

title: Can saliency maps flag chest radiograph classifier errors at a new hospital? An external validation study
zh_title: 显著性图能否在新医院标示胸片分类器错误
summary: 在美越两家外院共30余万次判定上外部验证，显著性图几乎未提升基于置信度的错误检测。
key_points: 模型训练于NIH ChestX-ray14，另在两家外院测试
Grad-CAM定位命中率最高0.575，低于放射科医生0.888
加入解剖富集度后错误检测AUC提升不超过0.011
reason: 两处独立外院、30万余次判定的外部验证且结论明确，属重要档
abstract: Saliency maps are offered as a safeguard for medical image classifiers, but whether they reveal individual errors at a new hospital remains largely untested. We trained a convolutional network and a vision transformer on NIH ChestX-ray14 and evaluated 303,768 decisions per model at the training hospital and at two external sites, in the USA and Vietnam, with radiologist-consensus labels. We scored each explanation by its anatomical enrichment, the area-normalized concentration of attribution in a segmented thoracic region, and tested whether it detects errors beyond the model's confidence. Grad-CAM localized findings less often than radiologists (hit rate at most 0.575 versus 0.888). Adding enrichment to a confidence-based error detector calibrated at the training hospital never raised its area under the curve by more than 0.011, and for the convolutional network the relation between enrichment and correctness reversed between hospitals, degrading the transferred detector. Model confidence, not saliency, should anchor deployment monitoring.
zh_abstract: 显著性图被作为医学图像分类器的一种保障措施，但其能否在新医院揭示个体错误在很大程度上仍未经验证。我们在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上训练了一个卷积网络和一个视觉 Transformer，并在训练医院以及美国和越南的两个外部站点，使用放射科医生共识标签，对每个模型评估了 303,768 次决策。我们根据每个解释的解剖学富集度（即归因在分割胸部区域中的面积归一化集中度）对其进行评分，并检验其能否在模型置信度之外检测错误。Grad-CAM 定位发现物的频率低于放射科医生（命中率最高为 0.575 对 0.888）。将在训练医院校准的富集度加入基于置信度的错误检测器，从未使其曲线下面积提高超过 0.011；对于卷积网络，富集度与正确性之间的关系在不同医院之间发生反转，导致迁移后的检测器性能下降。部署监测应以模型置信度而非显著性为依据。

abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly used to propose DNA sequences and edits. But successful design requires capabilities that current benchmarks do not measure. Here we introduce BEND 2.0 (BENchmark for DNA language models), which tests how well models predict the effects of DNA changes and whether these predictions can guide sequence design. Across eight tasks built on five experimental datasets, we find that model choice and how representations are accessed both affect performance. Linear readouts fitted to frozen representations can match or exceed models' native outputs, and functional post-training substantially improves the models' capabilities. Linear readouts transfer well across experimental assays and genes, suggesting that models capture functional patterns beyond the data used to fit individual predictors. At the same time, strong prediction of average effects can conceal weaker prediction of context-specific effects, and accurate prediction of combined mutation effects does not imply accurate prediction of their interactions. In design tasks, model predictions can reduce the number of candidates needed to find a desired response, but still leave substantial room for better design choices, particularly for context-specific and multi-cell objectives. Our benchmark reveals that genomic models now display signs of general utility but have yet to saturate on performance in even simple tasks.
zh_abstract: 基因组基础模型（genomic foundation models）正越来越多地用于提出 DNA 序列和编辑方案。但成功的设计需要当前基准未衡量的能力。在此，我们推出 BEND 2.0（BENchmark for DNA language models），它测试模型预测 DNA 变化效应的能力，以及这些预测能否指导序列设计。在基于五个实验数据集构建的八项任务中，我们发现模型选择以及表征的访问方式都会影响性能。拟合于冻结表征的线性读出（linear readouts）可以匹配或超过模型的原生输出，而功能性后训练（functional post-training）显著提升模型能力。线性读出在不同实验检测和基因之间转移良好，提示模型捕获了超出用于拟合各个预测器的数据之外的功能模式。同时，对平均效应的强预测可能掩盖对情境特异性效应较弱的预测，而对组合突变效应的准确预测并不意味着对其相互作用的准确预测。在设计任务中，模型预测可以减少找到期望响应所需的候选数量，但仍为更好的设计选择留下很大空间，尤其是对于情境特异性和多细胞目标。我们的基准揭示，基因组模型如今显示出通用效用的迹象，但即使在简单任务上，其性能也尚未饱和。

title: Sycophancy and Extended Engagement with Publicly Accessible Generative AI: Aligning Deployment with Mental Health Needs.

summary: 评论文章指出通用生成式AI对青少年及孤独、心理困扰人群存在心理社会风险，现有治理框架尚未覆盖此类对齐问题。

abstract: [Current psychiatry reports] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming a routine source of health information, emotional support, and companionship. As its use expands, the key public health question is not only whether these tools can support care, but whether their deployment is aligned with the mental health needs of the community. In this commentary, we argue that general-purpose AI systems pose distinct psychosocial risks, especially for young people and those experiencing loneliness or psychological distress. Emerging evidence suggests that sustained chatbot use may be associated with loneliness, reduced socialisation, emotional dependence, and problematic use, while sycophantic model behaviour may undermine users' capacity for self-correction and sustain a feedback loop of engagement. Current AI policy frameworks address governance and safety, but do not yet provide a coordinated response to these mental health risks. Realising the benefits of AI without preventable community-level harm will require independent longitudinal research, psychosocial safety benchmarking, transparent post-deployment monitoring, and safety by design principles.
zh_abstract: 【Current psychiatry reports】生成式人工智能（AI）正日益成为健康信息、情感支持和陪伴的常规来源。随着其使用范围不断扩大，关键的公共卫生问题不仅在于这些工具能否支持照护，还在于其部署是否与社区的心理健康需求相匹配。在本评论中，我们主张通用型AI系统会带来独特的社会心理风险，尤其是对年轻人以及正在经历孤独或心理困扰的人群。新出现的证据提示，持续使用聊天机器人可能与孤独感、社交减少、情感依赖和问题性使用相关，而迎合式（sycophantic）模型行为可能削弱用户的自我纠正能力，并维持一个参与度反馈回路。当前的AI政策框架涉及治理与安全性，但尚未针对这些心理健康风险提供协调一致的应对。要在避免可预防的社区层面伤害的同时实现AI的益处，需要独立的纵向研究、社会心理安全基准测试、透明的部署后监测以及“设计即安全”（safety by design）原则。

summary: 在B模式超声上构建两种黑盒对抗攻击，并评估三种推理期防御对甲状腺结节分割模型的影响。

abstract: [PLOS digital health] Deep learning-based segmentation models are increasingly integrated into clinical imaging workflows, yet their robustness to adversarial perturbations remains incompletely characterized, particularly for ultrasound images. We evaluated adversarial attacks and inference-time defenses for thyroid nodule segmentation in B-mode ultrasound. Two black-box adversarial attacks were developed: (1) Structured Speckle Amplification Attack (SSAA), which injects boundary-targeted noise, and (2) Frequency-Domain Ultrasound Attack (FDUA), which applies bandpass-filtered phase perturbations in the Fourier domain. Three inference-time mitigations were evaluated on adversarial images: randomized preprocessing with test-time augmentation, deterministic input denoising, and stochastic ensemble inference with consistency-aware aggregation. Experiments were conducted on a U-Net segmentation model trained on cine-clips from a database of 192 thyroid nodules. The baseline model achieved a mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 0.76 (SD 0.20) on unperturbed images. SSAA reduced DSC by 0.29 (SD 0.20), from 0.76 to 0.47, while maintaining high visual similarity (SSIM = 0.94). FDUA resulted in a smaller DSC reduction of 0.11 (SD 0.09), from 0.76 to 0.65, with lower visual fidelity (SSIM = 0.82). Against SSAA, all three defenses significantly improved DSC after correction, with deterministic denoising showing the largest recovery (+0.10, p < 0.001), followed by randomized preprocessing (+0.09, p < 0.001), and stochastic ensemble inference (+0.08, p = 0.002). No defense achieved statistically significant improvement against FDUA, although recall consistently improved at the cost of reduced precision. The tested inference-time defenses therefore partially mitigated spatial-domain perturbations, whereas statistically significant DSC recovery was not demonstrated against frequency-domain perturbations, highlighting attack-specific challenges in adversarial robustness evaluation.
zh_abstract: [PLOS digital health] 基于深度学习的分割模型正日益整合到临床影像工作流程中，但其对抗性扰动的稳健性仍未得到充分表征，尤其是对超声图像。我们评估了B模式超声中甲状腺结节分割的对抗攻击和推理时防御。开发了两种黑盒对抗攻击：（1）结构化斑点放大攻击（Structured Speckle Amplification Attack, SSAA），其注入边界靶向噪声；（2）频域超声攻击（Frequency-Domain Ultrasound Attack, FDUA），其在傅里叶域施加带通滤波的相位扰动。在对抗图像上评估了三种推理时缓解措施：带测试时增强的随机预处理、确定性输入去噪，以及具有一致性感知聚合的随机集成推理。实验在U-Net分割模型上进行，该模型在来自192个甲状腺结节数据库的电影剪辑上训练。基线模型在未扰动图像上达到平均Dice相似系数（DSC）0.76（SD 0.20）。SSAA使DSC降低0.29（SD 0.20），从0.76降至0.47，同时保持高视觉相似性（SSIM = 0.94）。FDUA导致较小的DSC降低0.11（SD 0.09），从0.76降至0.65，视觉保真度较低（SSIM = 0.82）。针对SSAA，三种防御在校正后均显著改善DSC，其中确定性去噪恢复最大（+0.10，p < 0.001），其次是随机预处理（+0.09，p < 0.001），以及随机集成推理（+0.08，p = 0.002）。没有防御对FDUA取得统计学显著改善，尽管召回率持续改善，但以精确率降低为代价。因此，所测试的推理时防御部分缓解了空间域扰动，而针对频域扰动未证明统计学显著的DSC恢复，突出了对抗稳健性评估中攻击特异性挑战。

summary: 预印本提出自主智能体，将冻结的AlphaFold3作为黑箱，按靶点假设迭代重构MSA与跨链配对，在三个新基准上提升界面DockQ。

abstract: Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate non-pairing.These results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.
zh_abstract: 使用AlphaFold 3进行蛋白质复合物结构预测依赖于MSA内容、深度和跨链配对。当前的流程采用统一方案，通常最大化深度并按物种进行配对，然而甚至连跨链配对是否有助于AF3仍存在争议。我们表明，深度和配对的价值都强烈依赖于目标，因此没有单一方案在所有界面上都是最优的。我们引入一个自主智能体，它将冻结的AF3视为黑箱实验仪器。对于每个目标，该智能体提出生物学假设，分析和重组MSA，并仅使用预测器的无标签信号迭代优化序列选择和配对。在来自AF3训练截止后发布的三个基准的1,015个蛋白质–蛋白质界面上，该智能体在每个基准上都比AF3默认流程和固定MSA方案提高了总体界面DockQ，同时平均使用的MSA序列比默认少60%。对于基于物种的配对不可靠的种间异源多聚体，增益最大：在FoldBench上平均DockQ从0.465增加到0.612，在HD439上从0.482增加到0.562。这些改进源于序列构建和配对策略两方面，包括有意不配对。这些结果将MSA设计重新界定为目标特异性问题，并表明自主智能体可以在测试时通过生物学推理和自主的、置信度引导的实验来调整MSA设计。

abstract: [JMIR formative research] AI technologies have considerable potential to support mental health practitioners in identifying depression symptoms. However, existing tools are often developed with limited practitioner involvement and evaluated primarily on technical performance, leaving questions of clinical relevance, ethical design, and practitioner trust insufficiently addressed. This study aimed to examine how iterative co-design with mental health practitioners can inform the development of an AI-based model for identifying depression symptoms, focusing on how practitioner input shaped its clinical relevance and ethical foundations across 2 design cycles. We conducted a 2-stage qualitative co-design study. In stage 1, we developed DepressionSymp 1.0, a fine-tuned GPT-3.5 model trained on the CounselChat dataset, identifying 5 symptom categories based on the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5) criteria and the Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC-22) psycholinguistic framework, reviewed and discussed by 6 mental health practitioners during online co-design workshops. In stage 2, this feedback informed DepressionSymp 2.0, expanded to 10 symptom categories and reviewed by 8 further practitioners in a second round of workshops. Practitioners valued the structured symptom outputs for reducing cognitive workload and supporting intervention planning. In stage 1, indirect indicators such as social withdrawal, financial difficulties, and major life changes were often classified as lifestyle factors rather than symptoms; this informed the expansion to 10 categories in stage 2, described as clearer and more useful for preassessment. Risk categorization was identified as the most ethically sensitive aspect across both stages, alongside broader concerns including the lack of nonverbal information in text-based assessments, cultural and linguistic differences in symptom expression, and the potential for automation bias without sufficient human oversight. zh_abstract: [JMIR formative research] AI技术具有相当大的潜力，可支持心理健康从业者识别抑郁症状。然而，现有工具往往在从业者参与有限的情况下开发，并且主要依据技术性能进行评估，导致临床相关性、伦理设计和从业者信任等问题未得到充分解决。本研究旨在考察与心理健康从业者进行迭代共同设计如何为开发用于识别抑郁症状的AI模型提供依据，重点关注在2个设计周期中从业者输入如何塑造其临床相关性和伦理基础。我们开展了一项两阶段定性共同设计研究。在第1阶段，我们开发了DepressionSymp 1.0，这是一个在CounselChat数据集上训练的微调GPT-3.5模型，基于《精神障碍诊断与统计手册》第五版（Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition, DSM-5）标准和语言探究与词数统计（Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count, LIWC-22）心理语言学框架识别5个症状类别，并由6名心理健康从业者在在线共同设计工作坊中审阅和讨论。在第2阶段，这些反馈为DepressionSymp 2.0提供了依据，该版本扩展到10个症状类别，并在第二轮工作坊中由另外8名从业者审阅。从业者重视结构化的症状输出，因为这有助于减少认知负荷并支持干预规划。在第1阶段，社会退缩、经济困难和重大生活变化等间接指标常被归类为生活方式因素而非症状；这促成了第2阶段扩展到10个类别，并被描述为更清晰且对预评估更有用。风险分类在两个阶段中都被认为是最具伦理敏感性的方面，同时还存在更广泛的担忧，包括基于文本的评估缺乏非言语信息、症状表达中的文化和语言差异，以及在缺乏充分人工监督时可能出现自动化偏差。与心理健康从业者进行迭代共同设计对于开发具有临床相关性和伦理基础的AI工具具有价值，展示了定性从业者反馈如何为迭代模型改进和伦理设计提供依据。研究结果为大语言模型（large language model, LLM）功能、从业者在环监督以及涵盖临床标准、知情同意和数据治理的伦理考量提供了设计启示。未来工作应优先考虑更大

abstract: Multimodal AI fusion of histology and clinical data is an active research area in computational pathology, but fusion methods are rarely compared under identical conditions and across different clinical endpoints. We present a modular framework in which slide-level embeddings, obtained by training an attention-based aggregator over patch embeddings from a frozen foundation model, and per-visit clinical embeddings are fed into 15 interchangeable fusion methods with a shared output dimension and prediction head (except decision-level methods). Using a prospective cohort of newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease patients, we predicted STRIDE-II-aligned remission outcomes from baseline or follow-up visits. The best fusion method reached macro-F1 of 0.57-0.75, outperforming both single-modality models in four of six scenarios, and differed by outcome and input. Image reliance, the drop in balanced accuracy when the slide embedding is removed, tended to follow the remission type - highest for histological and lowest for endoscopic remission; methods with similar accuracy relied on the slide to very different degrees.
zh_abstract: 组织学与临床数据的多模态 AI 融合是计算病理学中的活跃研究领域，但融合方法很少在相同条件下并针对不同临床终点进行比较。我们提出一个模块化框架，其中切片级嵌入（通过在冻结基础模型的 patch 嵌入上训练基于注意力的聚合器获得）和每次就诊的临床嵌入被输入 15 种可互换的融合方法，这些方法具有共享的输出维度和预测头（决策级方法除外）。使用一个新诊断炎症性肠病患者的前瞻性队列，我们根据基线或随访就诊预测与 STRIDE-II 一致的缓解结局。最佳融合方法达到 macro-F1 为 0.57-0.75，在六种场景中的四种优于两种单模态模型，并且随结局和输入而异。图像依赖度，即移除切片嵌入时平衡准确率的下降，倾向于随缓解类型而变化——组织学缓解最高，内镜缓解最低；准确率相近的方法对切片的依赖程度差异很大。

title: Does Your Trial Simulator Know What the Drug Does? An Intervention-Blind Test of Interventional Validity on 7,207 Registered Trials

summary: 从ClinicalTrials.gov的7,207项试验构建干预盲法参照，量化患者世界模型模拟临床试验时真正依赖干预信息的程度（预印本）。

abstract: Patient world models are increasingly proposed as simulators of clinical trials, and recent surveys rank their capabilities on a ladder from temporal prediction to counterfactual rollouts. Position on that ladder is currently assigned by reading papers rather than by measurement. We turn the counterfactual rung into a measured quantity. From 30,119 completed phase 2/3 trials with results posted to ClinicalTrials.gov we construct 9,996 audited within-trial contrasts from 7,207 trials, and we score a simulator on how much of its accuracy depends on knowing which intervention was tested. The instrument is an intervention-blind reference: the same model, trained on the same trials, with every intervention-identifying field withheld. Interventional skill is the error the full model removes relative to that reference. On a temporal split (878 test contrasts from 655 trials) a registry-trained gradient-boosting simulator removes a fifth of the error of a trivial baseline, but its interventional skill is -0.12 (95% CI -0.21 to -0.05): withholding the intervention makes it better, and no alternative featurisation, stratum, temporal cut or same-molecule retrieval yields an interval above zero. A frontier language model reading only the registered protocol has interventional skill 0.20 [0.08, 0.31]; smaller and open-weight models sit at the limit of detection. Perturbation tests show the large model uses the intervention as such: swapping the arms reverses the sign of its prediction in 86% of contrasts. The blind reference is itself not drug-blind (a language model recovers the withheld drug class 45% of the time from the blind prompt), so interventional skill is a conservative lower bound. A reliability layer shows that ranking by predicted error lowers it but that calibrated error control does not transfer under temporal shift. Benchmark, code, prompts and per-call model outputs are released.
zh_abstract: 患者世界模型越来越多地被提出作为临床试验的模拟器，近期调查将其能力从时间预测到反事实推演按阶梯排序。目前该阶梯上的位置是通过阅读论文而非通过测量来赋予的。我们将反事实这一层级转化为可测量的量。从ClinicalTrials.gov上发布了结果的30,119项已完成的2/3期试验中，我们从7,207项试验构建了9,996个经审核的试验内对比，并对模拟器进行评分，衡量其准确性在多大程度上依赖于知道所测试的是哪种干预。该工具是一个干预盲法参照：同一模型，在相同试验上训练，但所有可识别干预的字段均被隐去。干预技能是完整模型相对于该参照所消除的误差。在时间切分（来自655项试验的878个测试对比）上，一个在注册数据上训练的梯度提升模拟器消除了简单基线误差的五分之一，但其干预技能为-0.12（95% CI -0.21至-0.05）：隐去干预使其表现更好，且没有任何替代的特征化、分层、时间切分或同分子检索产生高于零的区间。一个仅阅读注册方案的前沿语言模型，其干预技能为0.20 [0.08, 0.31]；更小的模型和开放权重模型处于检测限。扰动测试表明，大型模型确实使用了干预信息：交换试验组别会使其在86%的对比中预测符号反转。盲法参照本身并非药物盲（语言模型在45%的情况下能从盲法提示中恢复被隐去的药物类别），因此干预技能是一个保守下界。一个可靠性层显示，按预测误差排序会降低它，但校准的误差控制在时间偏移下不能迁移。基准、代码、提示词和每次调用的模型输出均已发布。

title: Lesion Overlap Ranks PET Segmentation Models but Does Not Certify Patient-Level Tumor Burden
zh_title: PET分割模型排序与患者级肿瘤负荷误差
summary: 基于1014例autoPET研究比较五种PET分割模型，发现重叠度指标可对模型排序，但不能保证患者级代谢肿瘤体积可靠。
key_points: 共分析1014例FDG PET/CT，并在597例PSMA研究中复核
模型按平均Dice排序与按平均相对MTV误差排序一致
患者层面有16.8%（82/489）落在重叠度与误差不一致区间
reason: 大样本公开数据并跨示踪剂复核，提示评价指标局限，但为预印本、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Metabolic tumor volume (MTV) summarizes whole-body PET disease burden for prognostic stratification and treatment assessment. Automated MTV is useful only if its estimate is reliable for the individual patient, yet segmentation models are usually evaluated with overlap metrics such as Dice rather than burden error. We examined whether overlap metrics identify unreliable MTV estimates using 1,014 autoPET FDG PET/CT studies. We evaluated LesionTracer predictions held out from fine-tuning, compared five selected released models on 489 tumor-positive patients, and examined the findings in 597 PSMA studies. Across the five FDG models, ranking by higher mean Dice gave the same order as ranking by lower mean relative MTV error ($ρ=-1.00$, exact $p=0.017$). At the patient level, however, out-of-fold Dice tracked relative MTV error strongly ($ρ=-0.75$), yet 82 of 489 patients (16.8\%) fell on opposite sides of the Dice 0.80 and MTV-error 25\% thresholds. Within the training-exposed released models, correlations ranged from $-0.47$ to $-0.74$ over narrower, high-Dice ranges. Out of fold, opposing false-positive and false-negative volumes cancelled about one third of spatial error in net MTV. In 236 of 489 patients, each of the five models missed at least one lesion, though not necessarily the same lesion. Thus, agreement in average model rankings did not establish the reliability of individual MTV estimates or reveal shared lesion misses. PET segmentation benchmarks should report patient-level MTV error and missed-lesion counts alongside Dice and other overlap metrics.
zh_abstract: 代谢性肿瘤体积（metabolic tumor volume, MTV）概括全身 PET 疾病负荷，用于预后分层和治疗评估。自动化 MTV 只有在单个患者的估计可靠时才有用，然而分割模型通常使用 Dice 等重叠指标而非负荷误差来评估。我们使用 1,014 项 autoPET FDG PET/CT 研究，考察重叠指标是否能识别不可靠的 MTV 估计。我们评估了从微调中留出的 LesionTracer 预测，在 489 例肿瘤阳性患者上比较了五个选定的已发布模型，并在 597 项 PSMA 研究中检验了这些发现。在五个 FDG 模型中，按较高平均 Dice 排名与按较低平均相对 MTV 误差排名得到相同顺序（$ρ=-1.00$，精确 $p=0.017$）。然而在患者层面，折外（out-of-fold）Dice 与相对 MTV 误差强相关（$ρ=-0.75$），但 489 例患者中有 82 例（16.8%）位于 Dice 0.80 和 MTV 误差 25% 阈值的相反两侧。在训练暴露的已发布模型中，相关性在较窄的高 Dice 范围内为 $-0.47$ 至 $-0.74$。在折外，方向相反的假阳性和假阴性体积抵消了净 MTV 中约三分之一的空间误差。在 489 例患者中，有 236 例中五个模型每个都至少漏掉一个病灶，尽管不一定是同一个病灶。因此，模型平均排名的一致并不能确立单个 MTV 估计的可靠性，也不能揭示共同的病灶漏检。PET 分割基准应在 Dice 和其他重叠指标之外，报告患者层面的 MTV 误差和漏检病灶计数。

title: MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection
zh_title: MedPhysBench：评估语言模型的医学物理计算与查错基准
summary: 构建MedPhysBench基准，用1200道题评估语言模型的放疗剂量计算与差错检出能力。
key_points: 覆盖放疗、诊断影像、核医学与辐射防护
12个模型计算题得分33.3%–100%
同批输入设差错检出题，半数含植入错误
reason: 新基准有留出测试与多模型对比，但为预印本且未见公开说明
abstract: Medical physicists turn a prescription into a delivered dose and check one another's calculations, because one error in a beam calibration or a monitor-unit (MU) calculation can affect every patient treated with it. MedPhysBench has ten seeded generators of calculation items in radiation therapy, diagnostic imaging, nuclear medicine and radiation protection, up to clinical tasks such as a TG-51 calibration worksheet. Reference answers come from code implementing the governing protocols, and a grader converts units and applies tolerance bands. From the same inputs, separate checking items test error detection, showing a colleague's worksheet or only the colleague's result, half correct and half with one planted error. On a held-out test split of 1,200 items (half for two models), 12 models scored 33.3 to 100.0% on calculation. Of the nine answers graded incorrect for the four best (99.3-100.0%), five contained model errors and four followed NCRP Report 151 on points our items misstate or leave open. Below them, most models did worst on level-3 clinical tasks, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 omitted the inverse-square correction in 19 of 20 isocentric MU items. Five models detected at least 96.7% of mostly large planted errors with at most 4% false alarms; for four of the other seven, checking only the result raised false alarms significantly. In an exploratory targeted test with 20 public cases of an omitted inverse-square correction, the three best models tested caught it in every worksheet, and three weaker models accepted 16 to 18 of 20 planted worksheets, one of them while applying the correction in most of its own calculations. Claude Opus 5.5 accepted 6 of 20 wrong results, although it applied the correction in all 20 of its own. We report the effect of two problems in our shielding items, found after the runs, and release the code, per-item outcomes and targeted-test responses.
zh_abstract: 医学物理师将处方转化为实际递送剂量，并互相核对计算，因为束流校准或监测单位（MU）计算中的一个错误会影响使用该束流治疗的每一位患者。MedPhysBench 具有十个带种子的计算条目生成器，涵盖放射治疗、诊断成像、核医学和辐射防护，直至诸如 TG-51 校准工作表等临床任务。参考答案来自实施相应规程的代码，评分器会转换单位并应用容差范围。基于相同输入，单独的检查条目测试错误检测，向模型展示同事的工作表或仅展示同事的结果，其中一半正确，另一半植入一个错误。在包含1,200个条目的留出测试集上（其中一半用于两个模型），12个模型在计算任务上的得分为33.3%至100.0%。在四个最佳模型（99.3–100.0%）中，有九个答案被评分为错误；其中五个包含模型错误，四个是在我们的条目错误陈述或留待开放的点上遵循 NCRP Report 151。在它们之下，大多数模型在3级临床任务上表现最差，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在20个等中心MU条目中的19个遗漏了平方反比校正。五个模型检测到至少96.7%的（多为较大的）植入错误，误报率至多4%；在其余七个模型中的四个，仅检查结果会显著提高误报。在一项探索性靶向测试中，使用20个公开的遗漏平方反比校正案例，接受测试的三个最佳模型在每个工作表中都发现了该错误，而三个较弱模型接受了20个植入错误工作表中的16至18个，其中一个模型在其自身大多数计算中应用了该校正。Claude Opus 5.5 接受了20个错误结果中的6个，尽管它在其自身的全部20个计算中都应用了该校正。我们报告在运行后发现的两个屏蔽条目问题的影响，并发布代码、逐条目结果和靶向测试回答。

title: CARTnet: Template-guided B-cell Epitope Prediction with Contact-aware Attention
zh_title: CARTnet：模板引导的B细胞表位预测
summary: 预印本提出接触感知深度学习框架CARTnet，整合多模态特征与模板表位信息预测B细胞表位，内外测试集AUPRC均优于现有方法。
key_points: 内部测试AUPRC 0.243，高于DiscoTope-3（0.220）与BepiPred-3（0.198）
作者称外部测试结果支持其泛化性
reason: 预印本新方法含外部测试集与多基线对比，但提升幅度有限、未见代码公开，属值得一看档
abstract: B-cell epitope prediction remains challenging due to the limited availability of experimentally characterized data and the incomplete understanding of antibody-antigen recognition. Here, we present CARTnet, a novel contact-aware deep learning framework that integrates multimodal features and template-derived epitope information. CARTnet demonstrated superior performance when compared to the existing state-of-the-art methods across most evaluation metrics on both the internal and external test datasets. In particular, CARTnet achieved an AUPRC of 0.243 on the internal test set, compared with 0.220 for DiscoTope-3, 0.140 for BepiPred-2, and 0.198 for BepiPred-3. This improvement was also observed on the external test set, where CARTnet achieved an AUPRC of 0.267, compared with 0.192, 0.111, and 0.215 for DiscoTope-3, BepiPred-2, and BepiPred-3, respectively, supporting its generalizability. CARTnet also supports template-guided prediction, in which limited prior epitope information can improve the identification of additional epitope residues; a single template residue increased the AUPRC of the template-based variant from 0.225 to 0.403 on the internal test set. Furthermore, we demonstrated that epitope information from closely related viruses can be transferred across the genus Alphavirus to improve epitope prediction accuracy. These results establish CARTnet as an accurate framework for both de novo and template-guided B-cell epitope prediction.
zh_abstract: 由于经实验表征的数据可用性有限，且对抗体-抗原识别的理解尚不完整，B细胞表位预测仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出了CARTnet，一种新颖的接触感知深度学习框架，整合了多模态特征和模板来源的表位信息。在内部和外部测试数据集上，CARTnet在大多数评估指标上均表现出优于现有最先进方法的性能。具体而言，CARTnet在内部测试集上达到0.243的AUPRC，而DiscoTope-3为0.220、BepiPred-2为0.140、BepiPred-3为0.198。这一改善也在外部测试集上观察到，CARTnet达到0.267的AUPRC，而DiscoTope-3、BepiPred-2和BepiPred-3分别为0.192、0.111和0.215，支持了其泛化性。CARTnet还支持模板引导预测，其中有限的先验表位信息可改善额外表位残基的识别；在内部测试集上，单个模板残基将基于模板变体的AUPRC从0.225提高到0.403。此外，我们证明来自密切 related 病毒的表位信息可跨α病毒属（Alphavirus）转移，以提高表位预测准确性。这些结果确立了CARTnet作为适用于从头和模板引导B细胞表位预测的准确框架。

title: Diagnosis by Composition: Detecting and Localizing Unseen Diseases by Composing Learned Radiological Findings
zh_title: 组合式诊断：以影像征象组合检出未见过疾病
summary: 预印本提出“组合式诊断”表征学习框架，将影像特征对齐征象文本，按指南组合征象实现可解释的疾病检出与定位。
key_points: 先学征象词表，再由征象按指南组合定义疾病
疾病到征象映射固定且无参数，提升可解释性
目标是检出训练中未出现过的疾病
reason: 思路新颖的预印本方法，可解释性设计明确，但未见外部验证与代码，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.
zh_abstract: 用于放射学诊断的深度模型通常被训练为直接从图像预测疾病标签，这使它们仅限于训练期间见过的疾病，并使其决策难以用放射科医生的术语解释。然而，放射学通过已发表的指南从视觉发现推进到疾病，这些指南使该决策规则明确、可解释且可重复。我们提出组合诊断（diagnosis by composition，DbC），一种编码这种“发现优先”逻辑的表征学习框架。DbC通过将图像特征与发现的文本嵌入对齐来学习放射学发现词表，每个发现表示为扫描上的稠密图。一种疾病由其指南推导出的一组必需发现来定义，其诊断图是对应发现图的固定、无参数组合。由于发现到疾病的映射源自指南而非学习得到，DbC在设计上具有可解释性和可审计性，可通过指定新疾病的发现而无需重新训练来扩展到新疾病，并可通过组合其发现来诊断未见疾病。在多期肝脏CT上，DbC在检测和定位未见疾病、来自不同机构的罕见疾病以及一个外部队列方面显著优于所有对照方法，包括将图像与疾病名称对齐的模型。DbC还在全监督设置中改善了检测和定位，并在不同训练集规模下仍保持优越。尽管在肝脏CT上进行了演示，DbC适用于任何通过发现来定义疾病的放射学指南场景。

title: Weight-space programming for auditing clinical decision networks
zh_title: 权重空间编程审计临床决策网络
summary: 探索用权重空间编程的大模型，仅凭临床协议与网络权重盲审并修复放疗计划筛选网络。
key_points: 网络参数433至4801，按四条规则训练
植入混杂、阈值偏移与隐藏触发缺陷
每个结论与修复在约42万请求上测试
reason: 预印本，新审计法并在约42万请求测试，但网络小证据有限，值得一看偏上。
abstract: Machine learning models in radiotherapy are commissioned by testing them on cases with known answers, which may not reveal a shortcut that the test cases share with the training data. Frontier language models have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of small neural networks, an ability called weight-space programming. The purpose of this study was to determine whether such a model, given only a clinical protocol and a network's weights, can audit and repair the network. Networks with 433 to 4,801 parameters were trained to screen head-and-neck planning requests against four rules. Flaws were planted through the training data: confounds that hid each rule, a 3 Gy shift in the cord threshold, and a hidden trigger. Claude Opus 5.5 audited each network blind, without tools, data or code execution, and every claim and repair was tested on about 420,000 requests. The language model named the broken rule in 16 of 18 flawed networks (95% CI 67% to 97%), including all 15 with a confound or a threshold shift. It repaired each of the 16 by changing a median of 3 parameters. Fine-tuning on protocol-labeled requests also repaired every network, but changed nearly every parameter. Each confound and shift it found was visible in single units, and a simple statistic chosen for each flaw type found the same flaws. It cleared 2 of 5 healthy networks without being forced and found 1 of 3 triggers. Testing against the protocol detected every flaw, and black-box testing found the confounds and the shift faster. The results indicate that, in small networks, weight-space programming can locate and repair flaws that silence an input or shift a threshold, but cannot yet certify that a network is correct.
zh_abstract: 放射治疗中的机器学习模型通常通过在已知答案的病例上进行测试来验收，而这种测试可能无法揭示测试病例与训练数据共有的捷径。近期有报道称，前沿语言模型能够读取和写入小型神经网络的原始权重，这种能力被称为权重空间编程。本研究的目的是确定这样一个模型，在仅给定临床方案和网络权重的情况下，能否审计并修复该网络。研究训练了参数数量为433至4,801个的网络，用于根据四条规则筛查头颈部计划请求。缺陷通过训练数据植入：隐藏每条规则的混杂因素、脊髓阈值上3 Gy的偏移，以及一个隐藏触发器。Claude Opus 5.5在无工具、无数据、无代码执行的情况下对每个网络进行盲审，每项声明和修复均在约420,000个请求上进行了测试。该语言模型在18个有缺陷网络中的16个中指出了出错规则（95% CI 67%至97%），包括全部15个存在混杂因素或阈值偏移的网络。它通过改变中位数3个参数修复了这16个网络中的每一个。对方案标注请求进行微调也修复了每个网络，但几乎改变了每一个参数。它发现的每个混杂因素和偏移均在单个单元中可见，而针对每种缺陷类型选择的简单统计量也发现了相同的缺陷。它在未被强制的情况下判定了5个健康网络中的2个为正常，并发现了3个触发器中的1个。对照方案进行测试检测到了每个缺陷，而黑盒测试更快地发现了混杂因素和偏移。结果表明，在小网络中，权重空间编程可以定位并修复使输入失效或使阈值偏移的缺陷，但尚不能证明网络是正确的。

title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
zh_title: 用协作智能基准衡量AI智能体作为队友
summary: 提出协作智能基准，含240项可验证任务与8个协作维度，评估AI智能体团队协作能力。
key_points: 240项任务，覆盖8个协作维度
任务含临床病例与航空事故报告
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 新基准有可验证结果，但为预印本且非医学专用，属值得一看档
abstract: Progress in AI is often measured by what a single model can do on its own. Yet teams of AI agents are starting to make breakthroughs and discoveries in science, medicine, mathematics and software engineering. As AI begins to work in teams of agents and people, the ability to collaborate becomes a core part of their intelligence. Research on human teams has measured this ability for decades. Inspired by this, we introduce the Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark, which measures how well an AI agent works as a teammate. It contains 240 tasks across 8 dimensions of teamwork, from refusing an unsafe shortcut to checking the work that a weaker model leaves behind. Each task comes from a real record or an existing benchmark, from aviation accident reports and clinical cases to coding tasks and negotiations, and has a programmatically verifiable outcome. To isolate teamwork from individual capability, models are scored only on tasks that they can solve by themselves when they have full information. We evaluate 18 closed- and open-weight models and find that every model, across sizes and families, has clear weaknesses as a teammate, with the best model scoring only 82.2 out of 100. Frontier models almost always refuse unsafe shortcuts and report misconduct, yet they cave under interpersonal pressure, reaching the best overall deal in only 14% of conflicts, and their pass rate drops from 97% to 81% when they take over a task in which a weaker model has cheated. Crucially, general capability does not guarantee good teamwork, as models with nearly the same capability score differ by up to 11 points as teammates. The benchmark includes 160 public tasks with code and data, along with 80 held-out tasks for evaluation. As AI agents increasingly work alongside other agents and people, the ability to collaborate effectively is becoming a crucial capability to measure and develop.
zh_abstract: AI 的进展往往以单个模型自身能做什么来衡量。然而，AI 智能体团队正开始在科学、医学、数学和软件工程领域取得突破和发现。随着 AI 开始以智能体团队及人与智能体团队的形式工作，协作能力成为其智能的核心组成部分。数十年来，人类团队研究一直在测量这种能力。受此启发，我们提出协作智能基准（Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark），用于衡量 AI 智能体作为团队成员的表现。它包含 240 项任务，覆盖团队合作的 8 个维度，从拒绝不安全的捷径到检查较弱模型留下的工作。每项任务都来自真实记录或现有基准，从航空事故报告和临床病例到编程任务和谈判，并且具有可通过程序验证的结果。为了将团队合作与个体能力分离，模型仅在其拥有完整信息时能够自行解决的任务上评分。我们评估了 18 个闭权重和开放权重模型，发现每个模型，无论规模或家族，作为团队成员都存在明显弱点，最佳模型仅得 82.2 分（满分 100）。前沿模型几乎总会拒绝不安全的捷径并报告不当行为，但它们会在人际压力下屈服，仅在 14% 的冲突中达成最佳总体协议；当它们接手一个较弱模型已作弊完成的任务时，通过率从 97% 降至 81%。关键在于，通用能力并不保证良好的团队合作，因为能力几乎相同的模型作为团队成员时得分最多可相差 11 分。该基准包括 160 项带代码和数据的公开任务，以及 80 项用于评估的留出任务。随着 AI 智能体越来越多地与其他智能体和人类共同工作，有效协作的能力正成为一项需要测量和培养的关键能力。

title: Deep-Reorder: Refined Motion Correction for 3D Brain MRI via Iterative Data Regrouping.

abstract: [Magnetic resonance in medicine] Accurate and temporally high-resolution estimation of subject motion is paramount for effective motion-correction in MRI. This work proposes a novel approach for estimating subject motion within a 3D MRI scan with high temporal resolution. Starting from an incoherent sampling scheme, images are reconstructed from temporally ordered k-space fractions via deep learning, enabling motion estimation via registration between each image. Assuming the bulk of the motion is removed using these initial estimates, the remaining misalignment between k-space fractions is expected to be minimally correlated in time. Based on this insight, an iterative strategy is proposed in which shots are arbitrarily regrouped into new k-space fractions, regardless of their original temporal ordering, for subsequent motion estimation and correction. This effectively increases the temporal resolution of the approach, enabling individual correction of all shots. When applied to 3D T1w TFE MRI of the brain, the proposed approach "Deep-Reorder" estimated a unique motion state for all shots, producing significantly better estimations of retrospective motion compared to estimation without iterative data regrouping. On prospectively motion-corrupted scans with intentional head movement by volunteers, the proposed approach consistently improved image quality, producing less noisy images with reduced motion artifacts. In conclusion, the proposed approach, which is free of external tracking devices or navigators, effectively estimated 3D motion and corrected motion artifacts with increased temporal resolution.
zh_abstract: [磁共振医学（Magnetic resonance in medicine）] 准确且时间高分辨率地估计受试者运动对于MRI中的有效运动校正至关重要。本工作提出一种在3D MRI扫描内以高时间分辨率估计受试者运动的新方法。从非相干采样方案出发，通过深度学习从按时间排序的k空间片段重建图像，从而能够通过各图像之间的配准进行运动估计。假设使用这些初始估计去除了大部分运动，则k空间片段之间剩余的未对齐预计在时间上相关性最小。基于这一见解，提出一种迭代策略，其中将各采集段（shots）任意重新分组为新的k空间片段，而不论其原始时间顺序，以用于后续运动估计和校正。这有效提高了该方法的时间分辨率，使所有采集段的单独校正成为可能。当应用于脑部3D T1w TFE MRI时，所提出的方法“Deep-Reorder”为所有采集段估计了唯一的运动状态，与没有迭代数据重新分组的估计相比，产生了显著更好的回顾性运动估计。在志愿者有意头部运动的前瞻性运动损坏扫描上，所提出的方法持续改善图像质量，产生噪声更少、运动伪影减少的图像。总之，所提出的方法无需外部跟踪设备或导航器，有效估计了3D运动并以提高的时间分辨率校正了运动伪影。

abstract: [Southern medical journal] Artificial intelligence (AI) is used increasingly to support clinical care and documentation in health care, including patient rehabilitation. AI is used to increase efficiency, facilitate information transfer, and improve accuracy and consistency in assessment and treatment of medical conditions. AI can assist clinicians in correlating symptoms, tracking patient progress, and recommending evidence-based treatment protocols. This article first provides perspectives on the role of AI in managing lateral epicondylosis. It then embarks on a preliminary study that compares expert opinions with AI recommendations for evaluation and treatment and provides insight into how patient expectations are influenced by AI searches in comparison to clinician recommendations. Although AI offers the potential of valuable support, clinicians remain responsible for final decisions to ensure optimal patient outcomes. The role of AI continues to evolve in clinical practice. It holds promise for advancing standards in the nonoperative management of lateral epicondylosis with the caveat that clinicians-human beings-have the ultimate responsibility and accountability for appropriate application and decision making to thoughtfully care for patients and improve treatment outcomes.

abstract: [PloS one] Medical image segmentation occupies a pivotal role in clinical diagnosis and therapeutic planning. Conventional segmentation techniques struggle to accommodate the intricate representational attributes of medical images, while prevailing deep learning segmentation models predominantly adopt homogeneous single encoders and linear feature fusion paradigms, thereby exhibiting inherent limitations in contextual modeling, fine-grained feature excavation, and contour segmentation accuracy. To address such dilemmas, this paper proposes a Heterogeneous Collaborative Feature Extraction Network (HCE-Net). Establishing a dual-path heterogeneous encoding architecture, this network excavates complementary feature representations in a parallel manner. An Orthogonal Fusion Module (OFM) is elaborately devised to integrate Sobel edge priors with multi-scale convolutions, enabling the precise capture of edge and contour characteristics. A Diversified Receptive Field Module (DFM) is constructed to consolidate multi-scale detail manifestations and preserve global contextual cues. Furthermore, Adaptive Aggregation Connection (AAC) is embedded within skip connection branches to supplant conventional simplistic concatenation, efficaciously mitigating the technical bottleneck of heterogeneous feature fusion. Comparative experiments conducted on three publicly accessible medical datasets, encompassing dental radiographs, pulmonary CT scans, and retinal vascular images, demonstrate that HCE-Net substantially elevates segmentation accuracy, enhances boundary integrity, and ameliorates the general robustness of the model. It manifests distinguished application prospects across diverse medical image segmentation scenarios.
zh_abstract: [PloS one] 医学图像分割在临床诊断和治疗规划中占据关键地位。传统分割技术难以适应医学图像复杂的表征属性，而主流深度学习分割模型大多采用同质单一编码器和线性特征融合范式，因而在上下文建模、细粒度特征挖掘和轮廓分割准确性方面表现出固有局限。为解决这些困境，本文提出一种异质协同特征提取网络（HCE-Net）。该网络建立双路径异质编码架构，以并行方式挖掘互补的特征表示。精心设计正交融合模块（OFM），将Sobel边缘先验与多尺度卷积相整合，从而能够精确捕获边缘和轮廓特征。构建多样化感受野模块（DFM），以整合多尺度细节表现并保留全局上下文线索。此外，在跳跃连接分支中嵌入自适应聚合连接（AAC），以取代传统简单拼接，有效缓解异质特征融合的技术瓶颈。在三个公开可访问的医学数据集（涵盖牙科X线片、肺部CT扫描和视网膜血管图像）上进行的对比实验表明，HCE-Net 显著提升分割准确性、增强边界完整性并改善模型的整体稳健性。它在多种医学图像分割场景中展现出突出的应用前景。

zh_title: 乳腺钼靶数据集与AI检测的挑战与偏倚综述

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Breast cancer is still one of the main causes of death in women from cancer worldwide, and early detection is crucial. Mammography is the primary imaging modality for breast cancer screening and recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly enhanced automated breast cancer detection. This review takes a data-centered approach, examining key characteristics of public datasets, the contributions of mammography data to AI for breast cancer detection, and the implications for clinical generalizability. This review, however, takes a data-centered approach, critically analyzing characteristics of publicly available mammography datasets, and the role of mammography data to the development, performance and clinical generalization of AI models for the detection of breast cancer. The datasets are compared on the following aspects: dataset size, quality of the annotations, imaging modality, clinical metadata, dataset accessibility and demographic diversity. Analysis reveals that the quality, diversity and representativeness of the data used are critical for the performance and generalizability of AI models, ranging from the traditional machine learning era to the current era of deep learning, transformer-based systems, multimodal learning, explainable AI and privacy-preserving learning. The results show that, apart from the development of AI model architectures, it is a necessity to have standardized, diverse and clinically representative datasets to make further progress in AI-assisted mammography. The review emphasizes the importance of establishing a comprehensive benchmark dataset for mammography that is large and diverse to enhance reproducibility, to fairly evaluate models, and to develop strong, clinically viable AI systems for breast cancer detection.
zh_abstract: ［Frontiers in artificial intelligence］乳腺癌仍是全球女性癌症死亡的主要原因之一，早期发现至关重要。乳腺X线摄影（mammography）是乳腺癌筛查的主要影像学方法，人工智能（AI）的最新进展显著增强了自动化乳腺癌检测。本综述采取以数据为中心的方法，考察公开数据集的关键特征、乳腺X线摄影数据对乳腺癌检测AI的贡献，以及对临床可推广性的启示。然而，本综述采取以数据为中心的方法，批判性分析公开可用乳腺X线摄影数据集的特征，以及乳腺X线摄影数据对乳腺癌检测AI模型的开发、性能和临床推广的作用。这些数据集在以下方面进行比较：数据集规模、标注质量、成像方式、临床元数据、数据集可及性和人口学多样性。分析表明，所用数据的质量、多样性和代表性对AI模型的性能和可推广性至关重要，从传统机器学习时代到当前的深度学习、基于Transformer的系统、多模态学习、可解释AI和隐私保护学习时代均是如此。结果显示，除了AI模型架构的发展外，拥有标准化、多样化且具有临床代表性的数据集对于在AI辅助乳腺X线摄影方面取得进一步进展是必要的。本综述强调建立大型且多样化的乳腺X线摄影综合基准数据集的重要性，以提高可重复性、公平评估模型，并开发用于乳腺癌检测的稳健、临床可行的AI系统。

abstract: Evaluation of lymph node (LN) metastasis is critical for cancer staging and treatment planning. Since radiologic hallmarks of metastatic LNs are shared across primary cancers, a computed tomography (CT)-based deep learning (DL) classifier developed from one anatomy may transfer to others. This study built a DenseNet-121 ensemble model using clinical-implication-applied preprocessing and evaluated its cross-anatomical generalizability to LNs from diverse primary cancers. A DenseNet-121 ensemble model combining fixed-size cropping (FSC) and adjustable square cropping (ASC) was trained from ImageNet initialization on an axillary lymph node (ALN) dataset (n = 1,128 from 523 breast cancer patients). The model utilized clinical-implication-applied perinodal cropping with bicubic filtering and standardized resizing. To test cross-anatomical generalizability, an external dataset of 256 CT images across four anatomical regions was evaluated: cervical, mediastinal, upper-abdominal, and lower-abdominal LNs. Perinodal free margins were systematically varied from 10% to 40% to optimize the balance between context preservation and surround interference. Bicubic filtering and standardized resizing yielded the highest internal performance on the original ALN dataset (FSC-ASC ensemble area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC] 0.958, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.920-0.987 at 40% margin). The model demonstrated site-dependent, above-chance generalizability across all external regions. Cervical LNs achieved the highest performance at a 40% margin (AUROC 0.939, 95% CI 0.875-0.989). Mediastinal LNs peaked at a 10% margin (AUROC 0.796, 95% CI 0.672-0.903), with wider margins degrading performance due to adjacent structural interference. Upper-abdominal and lower-abdominal LNs reached optimal performance at a 30% margin (AUROC 0.814 for upper; AUROC 0.917 for lower). A single ALN-trained DL model can accurately predict LN metastasis across cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal stations through site-specific perinodal margin tuning. These findings support the feasibility of cross-cancer knowledge transfer and the clinical utility of generalizable backbones for pan-cancer nodal assessment.
zh_abstract: 淋巴结（LN）转移的评估对癌症分期和治疗计划至关重要。由于转移性 LN 的影像学特征在原发癌症之间共享，基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的深度学习（DL）分类器从一个解剖部位开发后可能迁移到其他部位。本研究使用应用临床意义导向的预处理构建了一个 DenseNet-121 集成模型，并评估其对不同原发癌症 LN 的跨解剖部位泛化能力。一个结合固定尺寸裁剪（FSC）和可调方形裁剪（ASC）的 DenseNet-121 集成模型，以 ImageNet 初始化在腋窝淋巴结（ALN）数据集（n = 1,128，来自 523 例乳腺癌患者）上训练。该模型采用了应用临床意义的淋巴结周围裁剪、双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸。为测试跨解剖部位泛化能力，评估了一个包含四个解剖区域共 256 张 CT 图像的外部数据集：颈部、纵隔、上腹部和下腹部 LN。淋巴结周围自由边距从 10% 系统变化到 40%，以优化上下文保留与周围干扰之间的平衡。双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸在原始 ALN 数据集上产生最高内部性能（在 40% 边距时，FSC-ASC 集成受试者工作特征曲线下面积 [AUROC] 0.958，95% 置信区间 [CI] 0.920-0.987）。该模型在所有外部区域均表现出部位依赖且高于随机水平的泛化能力。颈部 LN 在 40% 边距时达到最高性能（AUROC 0.939，95% CI 0.875-0.989）。纵隔 LN 在 10% 边距时达到峰值（AUROC 0.796，95% CI 0.672-0.903），更宽的边距因邻近结构干扰而降低性能。上腹部和下腹部 LN 在 30% 边距时达到最佳性能（上腹部 AUROC 0.814；下腹部 AUROC 0.917）。一个仅在 ALN 上训练的 DL 模型可通过部位特异性淋巴结周围边距调整，准确预测颈部、纵隔和腹部站点的 LN 转移。这些发现支持跨癌症知识迁移的可行性，以及可泛化骨干模型用于泛癌淋巴结评估的临床效用。

title: Evaluating uncertainty for detecting performance loss and guiding deferral after model transfer between hospital systems
zh_title: 医院间模型迁移后用不确定性检测性能损失并指导转人工
summary: 预印本在MIMIC-IV训练三个死亡预测网络并在eICU-CRD评估，发现熵与互信息不能可靠提示迁移后性能下降，但可辅助转人工。

abstract: Clinical prediction models often perform worse after transfer between hospital systems, but deterioration becomes apparent only once outcomes are known. We investigated whether uncertainty measures available at prediction time warn of performance loss and can help identify individual predictions requiring review. Three neural network architectures were trained on MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality prediction and evaluated on eICU-CRD. Measures included predictive entropy, mutual information from Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, and representation density. After transfer, AUROC fell from 0.86-0.87 to 0.76-0.77 and calibration worsened, while entropy and mutual information were lower. None of the measures reliably indicated the reduced performance. Deferring the 20% with the highest entropy reduced the remaining error rate from 17.5-20.1% to 6.3-8.0%; the deferred patients included 91-99% of false alarms but only 2-7% of missed deaths, which carried low uncertainty. Uncertainty therefore supported selective review but failed to reveal performance loss.
zh_abstract: 临床预测模型在医院系统之间迁移后往往表现更差，但性能下降只有在结局已知后才变得明显。我们研究了预测时可获得的不确定性度量是否能预警性能损失，并帮助识别需要复核的个体预测。三种神经网络架构在 MIMIC-IV 上训练用于院内死亡预测，并在 eICU-CRD 上评估。度量包括预测熵、来自蒙特卡洛 dropout 和深度集成的互信息，以及表示密度。迁移后，AUROC 从 0.86-0.87 降至 0.76-0.77，校准恶化，而熵和互信息更低。没有任何度量能可靠指示性能下降。推迟熵最高的 20% 后，剩余错误率从 17.5-20.1% 降至 6.3-8.0%；被推迟的患者包括 91-99% 的假警报，但仅包括 2-7% 的漏报死亡，而这些漏报死亡的不确定性较低。因此，不确定性支持选择性复核，但未能揭示性能损失。

title: Disentangling Context-Specific Alzheimer's Disease Progression Signatures through an Explainable AI Framework
zh_title: 可解释AI解析阿尔茨海默病进展特征
summary: ADVISE可解释深度生成框架从人前额叶单核RNA测序中分离Braak分期相关转录信号，识别共享与情境特异分子程序（预印本）。
key_points: 以分离潜表征剥离背景生物变异对分期的掩盖
在整体、性别与细胞类型层面比较AD进展特征

reason: 方法有新意且用大规模单核测序数据，但为预印本、缺乏独立验证
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression involves stage-dependent transcriptional changes that are often masked by dominant cellular and biological variation. Here, we present ADVISE (Alzheimer's Disease Variational Isolation of Signal Embeddings), an interpretable deep generative framework designed to disentangle Braak stage-associated transcriptional signals from background biological variation through separate latent representations. Using explainable AI, ADVISE prioritizes genes and pathways contributing to the disease-specific representation. Applying ADVISE to large-scale single-nucleus RNA sequencing data from the human prefrontal cortex, we identify shared and context-specific signatures of AD progression across global, sex-specific, and cell-type-specific analyses, revealing convergent molecular programs involving synaptic transmission, HSF1-associated proteostatic stress responses, and SLIT/ROBO axon guidance. Notably, ADVISE prioritizes ROBO2 as a progression-associated candidate in excitatory neurons. Experimental validation using CRISPR activation in hiPSC-derived excitatory neurons demonstrates that ROBO2 activation reduces the phosphorylated Tau-to-total Tau ratio. ADVISE thus reveals context-dependent molecular signatures of AD progression and bridges human single-cell discoveries with experimental validation of candidate regulators of AD pathology.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）进展涉及阶段依赖性的转录变化，这些变化常被占主导的细胞和生物学变异所掩盖。在此，我们提出ADVISE（Alzheimer's Disease Variational Isolation of Signal Embeddings），一个可解释的深度生成框架，旨在通过分离的潜在表征将Braak分期相关的转录信号与背景生物学变异解耦。利用可解释AI，ADVISE优先识别对疾病特异性表征有贡献的基因和通路。将ADVISE应用于来自人类前额叶皮层的大规模单核RNA测序数据，我们在全局、性别特异性和细胞类型特异性分析中识别出AD进展的共享和情境特异性特征，揭示了涉及突触传递、HSF1相关蛋白质稳态应激反应以及SLIT/ROBO轴突导向的趋同分子程序。值得注意的是，ADVISE将ROBO2优先列为兴奋性神经元中与进展相关的候选基因。使用CRISPR激活在hiPSC来源的兴奋性神经元中进行的实验验证表明，ROBO2激活降低了磷酸化Tau与总Tau的比值。因此，ADVISE揭示了AD进展的情境依赖性分子特征，并将人类单细胞发现与AD病理候选调控因子的实验验证连接起来。

title: XAMPGen: An Interpretable SI Pipeline For Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Discovery
zh_title: XAMPGen：可解释抗菌肽发现生成管线
summary: 在已知抗菌肽上微调ProGen生成新序列，并用可解释方法验证生成模型、定位编码关键功能信息的层。
key_points: 以生成式方法产出具目标性质的新型抗菌肽序列
用探针分类器与回归器识别关键功能层
自注意力分析用于解释生成模型并获取生物学线索
reason: 生成+可解释的方法有新意，但为预印本、缺少湿实验验证与外部对照，属值得一看档
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are short peptides with a broad spectrum of activity against bacterial pathogens, representing a promising avenue for combating the growing threat of antibiotic resistance. This study focuses on two main components: 1) generating novel AMPs with desired properties using generative SI (GenSI) and 2) utilizing explainable SI (XSI) methods to validate the GenSI model and derive biological insights. In this work, we fine-tuned ProGen, a decoder-only protein language model, on known AMPs to generate novel peptide sequences with strong antimicrobial properties. To advance the interpretability and reliability of the generative model, we applied Explainable SI (XSI) techniques. Specifically, we used a probing classifier and a regressor to identify cornerstone layers that encode functionally critical information. Self-attention analysis within these layers revealed residue level interdependencies and patterns underlying antimicrobial functions, which we validated against well-characterized AMPs from the literature. Overall, these methods provide mechanistic insight into the model's decision-making process, offering a principled basis for trusting the sequences it generates rather than treating the model as a black box. Candidate sequences were filtered based on predicted Minimum Inhibitory Concentration (MIC) along with human insights into the structural activities of the AMPs in bacterial membranes, and a final set of peptides was selected for experimental testing. Biological assays for determining MIC confirmed antimicrobial activity in all generated and tested peptides, with fluorescence and circular dichroism measurements providing structural insight. With our XSI approach, we are able to reveal correlations between amino acid sequence patterns and binding properties of these sequences to bacterial membrane mimics, that directly correlate with biological activities in cell-based assays. This builds confidence in that the learned amino acid interdependencies as applied to AMPs carries physico-chemical meaning and is relevant for discoveries of novel AMPs with therapeutic potential. This work demonstrates that interpretable generative language models can serve as effective and transparent tools for rational AMP discovery.
zh_abstract: 抗菌肽（antimicrobial peptides, AMPs）是对细菌病原体具有广谱活性的短肽，为应对日益严重的抗生素耐药性威胁提供了有前景的途径。本研究聚焦两个主要部分：1）使用生成式 SI（GenSI）生成具有所需特性的新型 AMPs；2）利用可解释 SI（XSI）方法验证 GenSI 模型并获得生物学见解。在本工作中，我们对已知 AMPs 微调了 ProGen——一种仅解码器（decoder-only）蛋白质语言模型——以生成具有强抗菌特性的新型肽序列。为提升生成模型的可解释性和可靠性，我们应用了可解释 SI（XSI）技术。具体而言，我们使用探针分类器（probing classifier）和回归器（regressor）来识别编码功能关键信息的基石层（cornerstone layers）。这些层内的自注意力分析揭示了残基水平的相互依赖关系以及抗菌功能背后的模式，我们对照文献中充分表征的 AMPs 进行了验证。总体而言，这些方法提供了对模型决策过程的机制性洞察，为信任其生成的序列提供了有原则的基础，而不是将模型视为黑箱。候选序列根据预测的最低抑菌浓度（Minimum Inhibitory Concentration, MIC）以及关于 AMPs 在细菌膜中结构活性的人类见解进行过滤，并最终选择一组肽用于实验测试。用于测定 MIC 的生物学实验证实所有生成并测试的肽均具有抗菌活性，荧光和圆二色性测量提供了结构洞察。借助我们的 XSI 方法，我们能够揭示氨基酸序列模式与这些序列对细菌膜模拟物结合特性之间的相关性，而这些结合特性与基于细胞的实验中的生物活性直接相关。这增强了对以下判断的信心：应用于 AMPs 的学习到的氨基酸相互依赖关系具有物理化学意义，并与发现具有治疗潜力的新型 AMPs 相关。本工作证明，可解释的生成式语言模型可作为理性 AMP 发现的有效且透明的工具。

title: Flexible Intensities Matter: A Comprehensive Re-evaluation of Hawkes Processes and Neural Temporal Point Processes
zh_title: Hawkes过程与神经时序点过程在医疗数据上的再评估
summary: 预印本在五个基准及UK Biobank、MIMIC-IV两个大规模医疗任务上重新比较不同灵活度的Hawkes过程与神经时序点过程。
key_points: 更灵活的Hawkes过程缩小既往性能差距
额外引入两个大规模医疗事件序列任务
任务形式为自回归下一事件预测
reason: 方法学再评估预印本，用大规模医疗数据但无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are the canonical framework for event sequence data, with applications spanning seismology, social media, and electronic health records. Recently, neural TPPs have been reported to substantially outperform classical TPPs, such as Hawkes processes, but these comparisons pitted flexible neural models against Hawkes processes in their most restricted form, and did not consider large-scale medical data. Here, we revisit this comparison through a systematic evaluation of Poisson and Hawkes processes of increasing flexibility against neural TPPs, on five established benchmark datasets and on two large-scale medical evaluation tasks derived from UK Biobank disease histories and MIMIC-IV ICU records, under autoregressive next-event prediction. First, the previously reported gap between Hawkes processes and neural TPPs largely disappears once Hawkes processes are equipped with flexible, learnable baselines and kernels. Second, the flexibility of the intensity parametrization also limits prior neural TPPs: a Transformer with a spline-based intensity head outperforms previous intensity-based neural TPPs and is on par with the intensity-free model. Decomposing the log-likelihood into a time term $\log p(t)$ and a type term $\log p(d \mid t)$, we find that this flexibility advantage lies almost entirely in the time density: more flexibility does not improve the type term. On these benchmarks, the gains of neural TPPs thus lie mostly in modeling when events occur, not which. Third, our results underscore the value of complex datasets for evaluating TPPs: only on the MIMIC-IV ICU records do neural TPPs retain an advantage in the type term. Our results inform both future method development and model choice. We release our framework, TorchPP, as an open-source package with consistent implementations of classical and neural TPPs.
zh_abstract: 时间点过程（Temporal point processes, TPPs）是事件序列数据的经典框架，应用遍及地震学、社交媒体和电子健康记录。近期有报告称，神经 TPP 显著优于 Hawkes 过程等经典 TPP，但这些比较是将灵活的神经模型与处于最受限形式的 Hawkes 过程相对比，且未考虑大规模医学数据。在此，我们在五个既有基准数据集以及两个源自 UK Biobank 疾病史和 MIMIC-IV ICU 记录的大规模医学评估任务上，于自回归下一事件预测下，通过系统评估灵活性递增的 Poisson 和 Hawkes 过程与神经 TPP 的对比，重新审视这一比较。第一，一旦 Hawkes 过程配备灵活、可学习的基线和核函数，先前报道的 Hawkes 过程与神经 TPP 之间的差距在很大程度上消失。第二，强度参数化的灵活性也限制了先前的神经 TPP：带有基于样条的强度头（spline-based intensity head）的 Transformer 优于先前基于强度的神经 TPP，并与无强度模型（intensity-free model）相当。将对数似然分解为时间项 log p(t) 和类型项 log p(d | t)，我们发现这种灵活性优势几乎完全在于时间密度：更高的灵活性并未改善类型项。因此，在这些基准上，神经 TPP 的增益主要在于建模事件何时发生，而非何种事件发生。第三，我们的结果凸显了复杂数据集对评估 TPP 的价值：只有在 MIMIC-IV ICU 记录上，神经 TPP 才在类型项上保持优势。我们的结果为未来方法开发和模型选择提供依据。我们以开源包形式发布我们的框架 TorchPP，其中包含经典 TPP 和神经 TPP 的一致实现。

title: C-WFDM: A ControlNet-Guided Wavelet-Fusion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Brain MRI Completion
